_about: Clean, chart-ready data for the /articles/pub-closures-in-the-uk/ refresh. Each dataset is one visual. Figures are transcribed from the 2026 source-research pack (deep-research-report). Every series carries geography, period, publisher, whether the source is original/official or secondary, a confidence rating, and a caveat. British English. Volumes are not rates; 'number of pubs', 'pub closures' and 'hospitality insolvencies' are DIFFERENT measures and must not be merged into one number.
_refresh_cadence: Closures and insolvency data at least quarterly; immediately after major policy changes to rates, duty, NICs or wage floors.
_geography_warning: UK, Great Britain and England & Wales are used differently by different sources. Do not restate a GB or E&W figure as 'UK'.

uk_pub_stock_over_time.title: Number of pubs in the UK
uk_pub_stock_over_time.source_publisher: House of Commons Library, quoting BBPA
uk_pub_stock_over_time.caveat: Secondary citation of BBPA data. Good for long-run framing; not a direct official dataset.

annual_closures_ew.title: Pub closures per year, England & Wales
annual_closures_ew.geography: England & Wales (2025 forecast is Great Britain)
annual_closures_ew.caveat: Trade-body closure series, not an official ONS/VOA business-death count. 2025 value is a BBPA forecast, not final outturn, and is Great Britain not E&W. Label it explicitly.

quarterly_closures_britain.title: Pub closures, Q1 comparison
quarterly_closures_britain.caveat: Britain, not UK. Trade-body closure series, not an official rating-list count. Q1 2026 ~= almost two a day.

permanent_losses_ew.title: Permanent pub losses, England & Wales
permanent_losses_ew.visual: bar chart with explicit definition note
permanent_losses_ew.source_publisher: Ryan analysis of government (VOA rating-list) statistics, via Guardian / Morning Advertiser
permanent_losses_ew.caveat: Permanent loss = demolition or conversion away from pub use. Total stock figure INCLUDES pubs that are vacant or being offered to let, so 'net stock' and 'permanent closures' are different. E&W only.

regional_hotspots_2025.title: Where pubs were lost in 2025 (England & Wales)
regional_hotspots_2025.unit: qualitative ranking (exact regional counts NOT in source pack)
regional_hotspots_2025.source_publisher: Ryan analysis via Guardian / Morning Advertiser
regional_hotspots_2025.caveat: DATA GAP: the research pack gives only the named hardest-hit regions, not exact regional counts. Every region lost pubs in 2025. Do NOT invent regional numbers. Either source exact figures before building this chart, or render as a labelled list of named regions.

hospitality_insolvencies.title: Hospitality company insolvencies vs pub closures
hospitality_insolvencies.visual: dual-axis or side-by-side small multiples (to show they are different systems)
hospitality_insolvencies.caveat: Accommodation & food service ACTIVITIES (SIC section), not pub-only and not site closures. A company can enter insolvency while sites keep trading; a pub can shut with no insolvency event.

figures.note: Accommodation & food service has had the HIGHEST sector insolvency rate every year since 2015.

business_demography.title: Accommodation & food service business births vs deaths

cost_pressure_survey.title: What is affecting hospitality turnover
cost_pressure_survey.source_publisher: ONS Business Insights and Conditions Survey (BICS)
cost_pressure_survey.caveat: Sample survey, sector-wide (accommodation & food service). Highly current.

cost_stack_policy.title: The 2025-2026 cost stack on pubs
cost_stack_policy.source_publisher: GOV.UK, HMRC, VOA / House of Commons Library, ONS
cost_stack_policy.caveat: Economy-wide policy changes, not pub-specific pay/bills. Rates figures are England only. Rateable value is not the final bill; duty is not shelf/bar price.

items.label: Draught duty rate (3.5% to <8.5% ABV)
items.note: vs main beer rate of £22.58 - draught relief

rates_revaluation_2026.title: Pub rateable values at the 2026 revaluation
rates_revaluation_2026.source_publisher: VOA via House of Commons Library
rates_revaluation_2026.caveat: Change in RATEABLE VALUE, not the final bill (multipliers and reliefs change the bill). England only.

points.category: Public Houses / Pub Restaurants incl. lodge

drinking_demand.title: Adults and drinking
drinking_demand.caveat: England only. Weekly-drinking figure is the lowest age group, not average.

pint_price_over_time.title: Average price of a pint of draught lager
pint_price_over_time.caveat: RPI average-price series for draught lager, not a 'typical pub pint' from trade commentary. Only the 2000 and 2024 endpoints are in the source pack; intermediate points need extraction from the ONS series if a fuller line is wanted.

community_pubs.title: Community-owned and community-run pubs
community_pubs.caveat: Advocacy/campaign framing. 'Community-owned' and 'community-run' are different categories; do not sum. Use for the rescue/replacement angle, not to overstate survival rates.

conversions_subsection.title: Freehold pubs sold for change of use
conversions_subsection.visual: single stat / used in prose only, NOT in the closures lead
conversions_subsection.caveat: Property TRANSACTIONS, not a national closures measure. Belongs only in a conversions/redevelopment subsection.
